# Preloader

Decides when the homepage splash screen leaves. The visuals are pure CSS in [hanko.css](../../styles/components/hanko.css); this folder only handles timing.

## What's here

- `Preloader.js` - waits for the intro, fonts and background video, runs the outro, then fires `preloader:out`
- `constants.js` - the fallback timers
- `deferred-videos.js` - starts loading card videos once the splash is gone

## How it works

- On a return visit in the same session the splash is hidden before first paint.
- Every wait has a fallback timer (for example 4 seconds for the video), so a slow asset can delay the landing animation but never block the page.
- `preloader:out` is the handoff to the choreography code. It fires once.

## How it connects

- Loaded by the [preloader script partial](../../views/templates/partials/preloader-script/preloader-script.njk).
- `LandingSequence` in [choreography](../choreography/README.choreography.md) starts when `preloader:out` fires.
